title: Hora Chadera - IFD Israeli folk dancing for beginners

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor demonstrates the steps solo while explaining them verbally and then practices with live percussion accompaniment. He guides the students through each section of the choreography with clear phrasing.

lesson_structure.note: Teacher introduces the dance title and background information
Step by step breakdown of the first part

common_mistakes: starting with left instead of right after closing with left

steps_taught.name: forward steps with heel
steps_taught.description: Four steps forward ending with a heel dig

steps_taught.name: step behind close
steps_taught.description: Stepping behind and closing in place

what_works: clear verbal explanations of foot placement
what_hinders: moving directly into full speed music practice

quotes.text: It's a Hassidic style of dance, very easy one.
Now holding hands, the last part starting with the right to the right.
It's not easy, but after two times or three you get used to do it.

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor demonstrates the first part of the dance facing forward, explaining hand and foot positions.

extraction.distinctive_method: integrating live drum accompaniment during the practice phase to help students maintain tempo.
